comment.body: Thanks for the original report and the report and two related user confirmations already posted. The assigned maintainer’s merged PR #47712 adds monitor-settings retention across discovery failures and stable monitor identity, which appears to address this reset pattern; however, the issue has no confirmation from a release containing that change. Could you share the PowerToys version currently installed and confirm whether the same per-monitor toggles still reset after sleep/restart or disabling and re-enabling the display? This will distinguish an already-covered report from a remaining regression without asking you to collect duplicate logs.
